exact_root_cause.historical_root_cause: The live Gate-10 5Q AIRouter smoke benchmark executed prior to Phase 14D-K, when benchmark/unified_evaluator.py lacked number-word to digit conversion (e.g. 'five' -> '5', 'eight' -> '8'). The live evaluator compared 'five' against gold '5' and returned False.
exact_root_cause.evaluator_edge_case_defect: In compute_correctness(), raw substring matching ('norm_gold in norm_pred') caused false positives (e.g. '8' in '18' evaluated to True) and failed on hyphenated compound numbers ('twenty-five' -> '20 5').

pub_001.synthesis_answer: According to the provided corpus, five biathlon events at the 2018 Winter Olympics had more than 73 competitors.

pub_003.synthesis_answer: According to the provided corpus, eight shooting events at the 2004 Summer Olympics had more than 37 competitors.

changes: Added _TENS and _UNITS compound mapping to _WORD_NUMBERS so 'twenty-five' normalizes to '25'.
Added normalize_dashes() to normalize_answer() so hyphens and unicode dashes (–, —) convert to spaces prior to punctuation removal.
Updated compute_correctness() to use token word-boundary matching (re.search(rf'\b{re.escape(norm_gold)}\b', norm_pred)) to prevent digit substring collisions like '8' matching '18'.
